scan.pinterest_status: Official Pinterest reporting, Pinterest Trends and public Pinterest design boards were checked on 7 October 2026. The new 6 October Pinterest Beauty Trend Report introduced a material specificity-first creative signal; other public design-board patterns repeated existing gradient, editorial, collage, risograph, inflated-type and neon-maximalism controls.
scan.chatgpt_status: Production v2.16.0 with 714 commands was read before editing. All commands, bundles, settings and monitor compatibility were preserved; v2.17.0 adds one reusable beauty-system command and is published with 715 commands. Browser installation remains locally observable only after userscript reload.
trends: beauty specificity: define an exact hero feature, placement, finish and palette instead of a generic look
makeup maximalism using one amplified focal feature
Arctic Frost reflective metallic, crystal and pastel-blue finishes
Cheeky Flush controlled high-blush placement with soft skin and blurred lips
Romantic Reverie natural texture and softly windswept portrait direction
Latte Lacquer dessert and orchard-inspired translucent finishes
Copper Waves layered mocha, cherry-cola, plum and oxidized-copper color
public design boards repeated existing vibrant gradients, risograph texture, inflated type, collage and neon-maximalist poster systems
skipped: No separate /makeup-maximalism alias because /beauty-trend-system defines the reusable feature-level behavior without locking the catalogue to a seasonal label

No separate /arctic-frost, /cheeky-flush, /latte-lacquer, /copper-waves or /romantic-reverie commands because these are selectable looks inside the new system and existing palette, material, portrait, makeup and hair controls

No new commands from public design boards because gradient posters, editorial layouts, collage, risograph texture, inflated typography and neon maximalism are already covered by existing visual-style, typography and layout intelligence
